name: plate_base
prompt:
Slot-game background scene, full-bleed wide landscape, no people in the foreground, no text except the sign: a cartoon ski resort at the foot of huge snowy mountains on a bright sunny day. Centre: a cosy two-storey wooden ski lodge with a snowy roof and a big chunky wooden sign on the roof that reads HIGH PEAKS, warm lit windows, a chimney puffing round green-tinted smoke clouds. Behind it tall white mountain peaks against a blue sky with a few fat cartoon clouds; a chairlift with little chairs climbs the slope on the right; snowy pine trees on both sides; a couple of cartoon cannabis plants in snowy wooden planters by the lodge door; a ski rack with colourful skis; a trail sign post with green circle, blue square and black diamond plates on the left. Plenty of calm snowy ground in the lower third. Symmetrical, readable, the lodge centred.

Style: flat 2D adult-animation TV cartoon (late-night animated sitcom look). Thick, even, confident black outlines; flat cel colours with at most one simple hard-edged shadow tone and one small white highlight; bright saturated candy colours; chunky, rounded, slightly goofy proportions; simple readable shapes. NO realistic lighting, NO gradients, NO painterly texture, NO 3D render, NO photo. Clean vector-like finish.
